title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes its edge function (step 4 of 4)
formal_statement: ∀ x1 ∈ [((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))], ∀ (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x3 → (∀ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x3.wires (List.ofFn x5)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = (x5 x1.1 || x5 x1.2)) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x3 = fun (x6 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) → (16 : ℕ) ≤ x3.size
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for it whose first gate computes the OR of one of the input pairs (0,1), (0,2), (0,3), (0,4), (0,6), (4,6) has at least 16 gates.
